## Quality Checklist

- [ ] Content is **generic** (not specific to a single project)
- [ ] Follows the **existing file format** (Purpose → Rules → Example → Checklist)
- [ ] Includes an example of **correct usage**
- [ ] Includes an example of **what is prohibited** (when applicable)
- [ ] No private project names or data included
- [ ] Triggers updated in `SKILL.md` if new activation keywords added
